Metabolic Intelligence (8-Yr Coin-Cell Schedule · 100% Cold Alerts Saved)
Metabolic Intelligence gives computers a strict energy budget before they act—from a freezing coin-battery food tag to a hundred-megawatt campus.
1) Give a computer a strict energy budget upfront, and design it to deliver the best verified answer inside that limit.
2) A food-freshness sensor tag can budget a coin battery for eight years and drop routine chatter in freezing cargo so critical alerts survive.
3) At the other extreme, a data center can follow power-grid caps by pausing flexible jobs and matching human reading speed.
